papers.title: Effect of Hydroxyapatite Nanowires on Formation and Bioactivity of Osteoblastic Cell Spheroid.
papers.abstract: Compared with traditional high-density cell spheroids, which are more prone to core necrosis, nanowires effectively improve the biological activity of core cells in spheroids, emanating more innovations for optimizing the internal cell survival environment and providing differentiation signals. In this study, hydroxyapatite nanowires (HAW), which provide numerous material exchange channels for internal cells by interpenetrating into cell spheroids, were added to osteoblast precursor (MC3T3-E1) cell spheroids. HAW, synthesized using the hydrothermal method, was used as a regulatory material to prepare uniformly sized 3D composite spheroids with good biological activity. Subsequently, material characterization and biocompatibility tests were performed on HAW, and the biological activity and osteogenic differentiation ability of the cell spheroids were tested. Notably, in 2D coculture, HAW displayed a certain attraction to MC3T3-E1 cells and promoted cell aggregation toward it. The content of HAW determined whether composite cell spheroids can form aggregated spherical structures, and incorporation of HAW alleviated core necrosis and enhanced the osteogenic phenotype. In summary, these findings indicate that the prepared HAW-bone cell composite spheroids can potentially be used as building blocks for the construction of large high-density biomimetic tissues and organoids using 3D bioprinting technology.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及人工智能技术，无法应用于AI生物打印方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed any AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow, has no experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance toward autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统高密度细胞球易发生核心坏死，亟需改善内部细胞存活环境。
summary_zh.method: 采用水热法合成羟基磷灰石纳米线，掺入成骨前体细胞球中形成复合球体。
summary_zh.result: 纳米线促进细胞聚集，缓解核心坏死，增强成骨表型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过材料表征和生物学实验验证纳米线的生物相容性和成骨分化能力。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional high-density cell spheroids suffer from core necrosis, motivating the development of strategies to improve internal cell survival.
summary_en.method: Hydroxyapatite nanowires synthesized via hydrothermal method were incorporated into MC3T3-E1 cell spheroids to form composite spheroids.
summary_en.result: The nanowires facilitated cell aggregation, alleviated core necrosis, and enhanced osteogenic differentiation.
summary_en.validation: Material characterization and in vitro biocompatibility tests confirmed the bioactivity and osteogenic potential of the composite spheroids.

papers.title: Predicting Early Hospital Discharge Following Revision Total Hip Arthroplasty: An Analysis of a Large National Database Using Machine Learning
papers.first_author_affiliation: Virginia Commonwealth University School of Medicine, Richmond, Virginia

corresponding_authors.name: Teja Yeramosu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Virginia Commonwealth University School of Medicine, Richmond, Virginia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注翻修全髋关节置换术后早期出院的临床预测，未涉及任何生物力学分析或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress, micromotion, or any implant-bone interface mechanics; it is a purely clinical outcome prediction study using database analysis, not biomechanical simulation or finite element analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测翻修全髋关节置换术后早期出院，以优化资源分配。
summary_zh.method: 使用大型国家数据库和机器学习模型（如随机森林、逻辑回归）进行分析。
summary_zh.result: 机器学习模型能有效识别早期出院的相关因素。
summary_zh.validation: 基于数据库的交叉验证，无实验或生物力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To predict early hospital discharge following revision total hip arthroplasty for better resource allocation.
summary_en.method: Machine learning models were applied to a large national database to identify predictors of early discharge.
summary_en.result: Machine learning models effectively identified factors associated with early discharge.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through database cross-validation without any experimental or biomechanical testing.
